contests.title: PayPal AI Hackathon
contests.description: About the challenge PayPal already moves money for millions of people and businesses, every day, all over the world. This hackathon is us opening that platform up and asking what happens when you put AI behind the wheel. New agents, new ways to pay and get paid, tools nobody's built yet. We want to see what you make of it. AI is changing how people build, buy, sell, work, connect, and move money. Now it's your turn to imagine what comes next. Build What's Next with PayPal and AI is a global online hackathon inviting developers, designers, founders, students, and builders to create something new using PayPal and AI. There are no prescribed problem statements and no set of tracks. Build an agent, an app, an automation, a new payment experience, a business tool, a social product, or something we haven't thought of yet. The only fundamental requirement: your project must meaningfully use both PayPal and AI. Why Join? Build something ambitious — Turn an idea into a working project using PayPal and AI. Explore what’s next — Experiment with new ways people, businesses, and AI agents can interact with money and payments. Win part of $69,750 in total prizes — Compete for overall prizes and special awards across creativity, impact, execution, and more. Show what you can build — Put your project in front of PayPal judges, developers, and the wider hackathon community. Learn by building — Explore PayPal APIs, AI tools, agents, automations, and emerging development workflows. Build your way — Join individually or as a team, and start something new or meaningfully advance an existing project. Get started Get a PayPal Developer account (5 minutes) Review example projects and brainstorm your own (30 minutes) Webinars Oct 6th 9am PT - 9:45am PT ~ Start building with PayPal Recording Oct 7th 9am PT - 9:30am PT ~ Power Your PayPal Hackathon Project with APIMatic Context Plugins Oct 12th 7am PT - 7:45am PT ~ Build a payments dashboard without building a dashboard Oct 13th 1am PT - 2am PT ~ Start building with PayPal

Work across a crew of agents in Kiro Crew, add structure with specs, customize workflows with hooks or steering, streamline with Kiro powers, or bring in new capabilities with MCP. Need Kiro credits to build your project? Registered participants can request them for the Submission Period. Details are on the Resources tab.

Atlassian’s Teamwork Graph connects goals, work, people, decisions, and outcomes like associative memory for your organization, giving teams the shared understanding of who’s doing what, what’s already been decided, and what needs to happen next. That's the problem Atlassian is built to solve. And it's the problem we're inviting you to tackle. Build an app on Atlassian’s Forge platform that uses that context to help teams ship with confidence – whether that’s surfacing the right knowledge at the right moment, connecting work across silos, or turning organizational data into a decision that actually moves work forward. Join the live Build Session Tue, Nov 17, 12:00 to 12:45 PM ET on Zoom. Danny Thompson, Senior Developer Advocate at Atlassian, and Adam Moore, Group Product Manager, Forge, show how to build AI workflows with Atlassian Forge and Rovo, followed by live Q&A. Set up Forge first and you can build along. The recording will be on YouTube afterward. Register for the Build Session

contests.title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026 on AI NAS
contests.description: UGREEN is opening AI NAS to developers through UGOS and Skills Hub. Powered by UGOS, UGREEN's own Linux-based operating system, UGREEN AI NAS brings local storage, computing, and AI capabilities together in one platform. UGOS makes it easy to keep your data secure, find and organize your files, and get more done with AI.With the UGOS Skill Creation Tool and your preferred AI assistant, you can create custom Skills that use supported NAS capabilities to organize files, find information, and automate everyday tasks. UGREEN Skills Hub gives developers the freedom to explore new ideas, create innovative tools, and expand what AI NAS can do. You bring the ideas. We'll help you build them. Access developer resources and technical support, with opportunities to win prizes, gain exposure through UGREEN, and explore future collaborations. No UGREEN NAS is required to enter. Finalists will receive free access to a UGREEN AI NAS iDX6011 Pro environment for final development, testing, and validation. The Hackathon has two rounds: Round 1 (open to all): Share your idea and an early build of your Skill. You do not need a NAS to enter. Download the UGREEN Skill Developer Package. Then submit a short PDF and a Pre-test Skill Package (ZIP). Round 2 (Finalists only): UGREEN will select up to 30 Finalists. Each Finalist gets one assigned testing day of free remote access to a real UGREEN AI NAS to install, test, and polish their Skill. Finalists then submit their final Skill and a short demo video to compete for $46,000 in cash prizes! Get Started: 🧠 Get to know UGREEN AI NAS. Learn what it can do. 💬 Join the UGREEN Community. It's a place to find teammates, compare approaches, and get help when you're stuck, while keeping up with official Hackathon news and development resources and discovering community perks. ✨ 📦 Download the UGREEN Skill Developer Package. It has the tools and technical docs you need. You must use this package to build your Skill. 🛠️ Brush up on helpful skills. Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, Linux and Docker, AI agent and tool design, and file or media processing are all useful here. Why Participate 💰 Compete for $46,000 in cash prizes. Five winners will share the prize pool, including two Most Creative awards. 🚀 No NAS needed to start. Round 1 is open to everyone. You only need your idea, the Skill Developer Package, and your code. 🖥️ Test on real hardware for free. Each Finalist gets one assigned testing day of free remote access to a UGREEN AI NAS iDX6011 Pro. 🎨 Build what you care about. Choose from four tracks: work automation, personal memories, creative media, or your own original idea. 🤝 Connect with the UGREEN team. Access developer resources and technical support, with opportunities to win prizes, gain exposure through UGREEN, and explore future collaborations.

contests.title: #BuildHybridAI 2026
contests.description: Main description On-device models are fast, private and free to run, but they aren't on every device. #BuildHybridAI challenges you to build apps that use both. Using the Firebase AI Logic Hybrid Inference SDK, your app runs prompts on-device when a local model is available and falls back to the cloud when it isn't. Build for at least one platform: Web (Chrome) or Android with Gemini Nano 4, or iOS with Apple Foundation Models, all through Firebase AI Logic. Want to go further? Apps that run across multiple platforms will be given strong consideration for the Grand Prize, since that's where a single hybrid SDK really shines. An outstanding single-platform app can still win. For example: a notes app that summarizes on-device offline and hands long documents to the cloud. New projects and significantly updated existing apps are both eligible, and the competition is open to individuals, teams and organizations in most countries (see the Official Rules). Why join? $30,000 in cash prizes, including a $10,000 Grand Prize and a $3,000 award for the best app on each platform Top winners get an interview and a featured blog post from the Firebase team Learn hybrid inference: one SDK for on-device and cloud AI across Web, Android and iOS Bring an existing app — it's eligible if significantly updated during the competition Start free: text inference with Firebase AI Logic is free within usage limits, and you can request a Google Account Quota for advanced features such as image generation Get started Join #BuildHybridAI on the Devpost Discord to find teammates and ask questions in #hackathon-help Read Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference and the guide for your platform on the Resources page Register for the Build Session with Cynthia Jiang from the Firebase team on Thu Nov 12 at 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET — save your spot on Luma Use Coding agents with Firebase agent skills (compatible with Antigravity, Claude, etc). Read What to Submit below before you build — a working demo app, a public repo, a demo video and a text description are all required

contests.title: QNX Global Hackathon
contests.description: For decades, QNX has been running the systems people bet their lives on, from medical devices and factory floors to trains, robots, and more than 275 million vehicles. It guarantees not just that your code runs, but exactly when. Now QNX 8.0 is free for non-commercial use, and the QNX team wants to see what you do with it when nobody hands you a spec. Build a robot that reacts in microseconds instead of milliseconds. Write the driver nobody has written yet. Port something you love to QNX, or build the tooling you always wished existed. If it runs on QNX 8.0, or helps someone else build for it, it counts. Pick your category and compete for a share of $50,000. Show us what you can do! Why join? Get your hands on a real-time OS, free. QNX Everywhere gives you QNX SDP 8.0, QNX Developer Desktop, and the QNX Hypervisor for non-commercial use, plus free training courses to get you moving. No target hardware required; QEMU works, and so does a Raspberry Pi 5. In 275 million vehicles. Now on your laptop. Not a teaching edition or a stripped-down trial. It's the same QNX that ships in commercial systems, and until QNX Everywhere, building on it meant a commercial license. Compete for $50,000 in prizes. Plus swag, a coffee chat with a QNX exec, and a feature on the QNX blog and social channels. Get Started Get free access to QNX SDP 8.0 through QNX Everywhere (5 minutes) Run through the QNX SDP 8.0 Quick Start Guide and get a program running on your target or QEMU (45 minutes) Browse QNX sample projects and open-source ports, then pick your category (30 minutes)

contests.title: DSH Hacks V2 ($100k+ in prizes!)
contests.description: DSH Hacks V2 is a global student competition open to students aged 13+ hosted collaboratively by three youth-led organizations: DeltaForge Hacks, NXT Horizon, and STEMise. Theme: AI x Healthcare This event brings together young innovators from around the world to transform bold ideas into technical products that address the health challenges facing our world today. Participants will work individually or in teams to identify a real-world healthcare problem and design and develop a meaningful technical solution. Projects may range from diagnostic tools tackling global disease burdens, to patient-care platforms improving access and outcomes, to AI-powered systems reimagining how we detect, treat, and manage illness. Creativity, feasibility, technical depth, clinical insight, and real-world impact will be central to evaluation. The theme of this competition is to build technical solutions that solve pressing healthcare problems. These solutions can be an app, a website, a simulation, a system, or an algorithm. Participants are encouraged to use AI to help them build a meaningful solution and to lower the technical barrier that poses challenges for beginners with ambitious project ideas.

contests.description: About the challenge Arbiter Hacks V1 runs two parallel tracks. Pick one when you register, or switch before the submission deadline. You may only submit to one track. General Track: Build anything. Any language, any stack, any idea. This track rewards technical ambition and execution, regardless of subject. Theme Track, Rethinking Waste: Build something that helps people or systems reduce, sort, or recycle waste more effectively. Examples include a tool that identifies whether an item is recyclable, an app that routes food waste to donation, a hardware or vision system that sorts materials, or a dataset or model that improves recycling accuracy. If it moves the needle on waste, it fits. The tracks are judged separately, against separate rubrics, for separate prizes. A polished General submission and a high-impact Theme submission compete only within their own track. Get started Register and pick a track. Form a team of [1 to 4] or go solo. Late submissions are not judged.

contests.title: 全新升级！第二届具亮计划·全球具身智能黑客松开启报名
contests.description:
全新升级！第二届具亮计划·全球具身智能黑客松开启报名

2026年3月，自变量发起和举办首届「具亮计划」黑客松，聚焦从数据采集、模型训练到真机部署的全链路实践。彼时，模型的能力仍受限于训练中见过的任务，想让机器人完成一项新任务，往往需要先采集对应数据，再进行针对性训练。如今，这一前提正在被打破。随着具身基础模型已经能够理解物理世界，在陌生任务上实现零样本泛化，具身智能第一次具备了像大语言模型一样可通过API直接被调用的条件。以这一技术演进为基础，2026年11月，自变量将在美国·硅谷与中国·深圳，举办第二届具亮计划·全球具身智能黑客松Embodied Agent Hackathon，本次比赛自变量将直接提供VLA和WAM具身基础模型的API，结合Agent，搭配机器人硬件，大大简化开发流程。以零样本开放世界操作为核心能力，无需任何任务适配，仅凭自然语言指令驱动，即可在全新场景中完成从任意物体抓取放置，到柔性物体操作、双臂协同与工具使用的各类任务。选手无需采集数据、无需微调模型，结合Agent即可开展任务开发，把精力真正投入到长程复杂任务的攻克上。你可以自由选择模型、组合技术、探索不同路径，用真实任务检验自己的设计和想法。从构想操作任务到机器人自主执行，期待你的方案在现场交出答卷！
